moments.selftext: A group of high school students volunteers to carry the caskets of homeless veterans who have no family to attend their funerals. Students at the University of Detroit Jesuit High School volunteer to carry the caskets of homeless and unclaimed veterans. Through the St. Joseph of Arimathea Pallbearer Ministry, founded in 2015, the teenagers wear formal suits and white gloves to ensure these forgotten veterans receive a dignified military burial, serving as the family they no longer have.
